new: A canvas workspace with Home idea drafts, sketches, artwork and GitHub import, plus contextual board tools and an assistant.
Placement and Mechanical workflows are available within the canvas, with separate layout copies and enclosure review controls.
improved: Consistent workspace navigation, grouped editing tools and clearer source and output review.
Organized saved outputs with image, video and 3D previews, bulk selection and recoverable Trash.
fixed: Switching agents and models in a conversation no longer depends on saving future defaults; failure messages are more compact.
Missing connection endpoints explain what to select before adding a cable guide.

improved: Updates install themselves: after the download, Restart to update replaces the app and reopens it, with no installer window to drag.
